name: ryu.ego-browser
description: Ego lite (https://github.com/citrolabs/ego-lite) as an optional provider for Ryu's swappable browser.control layer. Each call launches the installed ego-browser CLI in a conversation-scoped Ego Space, while agents keep using the stable browser.navigate, browser.tabs, browser.snapshot, browser.click, browser.type, browser.scroll, and browser.screenshot verbs. Requires the Ego lite macOS app and ego-browser on PATH; Ryu does not install Ego lite or copy browser login state.
